terra.problem: “Nobody passed this along to him” goes beyond the text. The writer describes firsthand experience, but does not say nobody else told him about it.
“That's the whole reason” makes the stated purpose exclusive. The writer also says they write so that their joy may be complete (1 John 1:4).
“More fellowship” adds a comparison the verse does not make. It says we have fellowship with one another, not that fellowship increases.
The cookie-box punchline mixes an unexplained circle with a box and its lid, and makes a joke in the middle of explaining Jesus' atoning sacrifice.
